verdict.rationale: Windmill's in-product AI lets users ask it, in natural language, to edit items and then review and deploy them (Compare & Deploy). Its official MCP integration also lets LLM chat clients trigger scripts and flows. The evidence covers authoring, deployment and execution only, not operating the product as a whole. Missing for 10: evidence of natural-language control of broader operations (schedules, triggers, permissions, workspace admin), detail on the in-app AI command scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Once the AI has edited items, ask it to review the changes and it opens the Compare & Deploy page with exactly those items preselected, ready to deploy.
allowing you to trigger your scripts and flows from your client chat
